title: Verified: practical teacher and local JavaScript / PowerShell console
summary: Runtime, UI interaction, access restrictions and history checks passed. Local lab backend is running; production is unchanged.

changes.detail: Resolved the initial React effect lint failure using keyed lab state, and added a process-termination fallback when Windows taskkill fails.
Verified manual review/run flow, output-to-teacher draft and owner/origin/input execution gates with interaction tests.

validation.name: Actual runtime tests
validation.detail: 3 tests passed: real Node.js and Windows PowerShell output/errors, secret environment omission, timeout, output bounds, cancellation, concurrent-run rejection, local/production gates.

validation.name: Lab UI and route tests
validation.detail: 2 tests passed with jsdom and mocked network/auth: no automatic execution, review required, real response displayed, exact executed code included in explanation draft, owner/origin/input gating.

validation.name: Teacher and history regression tests
validation.detail: 21 tests passed, including history expansion/links/statuses, retries, persistence, append retention and teacher validation/routes.

validation.name: Typecheck and focused lint
validation.detail: Learning app TypeScript check and ESLint for TeacherLab, TeacherMessage and MobileTeacher passed after correction.

validation.name: Live local HTTP checks
validation.detail: Teacher route HTTP 200; lab preflight 204 with expected CORS; unauthenticated POST 401; foreign-origin POST 403. API running on 127.0.0.1:3002 via explicit lab launcher.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No visual browser QA or real provider teaching conversation performed. Full owner-authenticated browser execution was not tested end to end; runtime and UI layers tested separately. Native remote terminal unsupported. No production deployment. Local terminal is not a sandbox and has access with the server user permissions.
